goal:
T61 — presentation mode for the demo video (v3.8 §4.4 / VIDEO-01: record the real stored snapshots, 16:9, no
staging). Web only.
1. apps/web/lib/roundReplay.ts: presentationFrames(run) -> [] for null/no rounds, else, walking rounds in index order and
   stopping at the first round where either side is PENDING (or missing): one {kind: "round", index, name, evoforge: P,
   single: P, cost: {evoforge, single}} per round, with P = {status, score "passed/n" (or "—"), previewHtml (that side's
   preview_html or null)} and cost = cumulative cost_cents up to and including that round, formatted "N¢"; then one
   final {kind: "summary", first (first frame index), latest (last frame index), verified: {evoforge: "k/F", single:
   "k/F"} (READY rounds among the F round frames), label: "Recorded run " + run_id}. Return [] when there is no round
   frame.
2. apps/web/components/PresentationView.tsx: full-screen 16:9 stage (aspect-ratio 16 / 9 or Tailwind aspect-video)
   showing one frame at a time: header with round name and both sides' status, score and cumulative cost; EvoForge left
   and single AI right as large SandboxedPreview; the summary frame shows R{first} and R{latest} previews of both sides
   and the verified counts; a persistent "Recorded run <id>" label and the manifest comparison mode. Auto-advance every
   4 s with pause / next / previous / exit (Esc) controls. No fetch( in this file.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/replay/page.tsx: a "Present" button on the selected run and support for ?present=1&run=<id>
   that renders PresentationView for that run (the page still loads the run with its existing GET loader).
4. i18n "replay" (en + ko) for the new labels.
Keep tsc green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t61.py.
